title: Terms of use and privacy policy
intro: By using mtgmods.com or the Arizona&Rodina Helper script (the ‘Helper’), you agree to the terms below.
If you do not agree, please leave the website and delete the script.

rich.liabilitySite: The current version is always available at <site>mtgmods.com/terms</site>.

blocks.text: MTG MODS is an independent project run by a single enthusiast developer.
The project is not a commercial organization or legal entity.
The project is not associated with or affiliated with Rockstar Games, GTA San Andreas, SA-MP, Arizona Games, MoonLoader or MonetLoader.
You use the Helper at your own risk.
You are responsible for ensuring that use of the script complies with the rules of the server you play on.
Free version
Provided for personal, non-commercial use.
You may study and modify the source code of the free version solely for your own needs.
Any commercial use, including selling, monetization or inclusion in paid bundles, is prohibited.
VIP version
The VIP version is proprietary, closed-source software.
The license grants only the right to use the script.
Decompiling, reverse engineering, modifying the paid file or attempting to bypass the licensing system is prohibited.
The service only collects data needed to operate, protect against piracy and produce aggregate statistics.
Account and website data
The website does not use advertising trackers.
Only access and refresh tokens are stored in your browser to maintain your session.
Authentication uses official OAuth protocols (Telegram, Discord). We do not see, receive or store your passwords.
Your profile stores your Telegram ID / Discord ID, nickname, avatar URL, role, account status, registration date and last sign-in date.
Localized prices and payment methods
For your convenience, mtgmods.com automatically hides payment methods unavailable in your region and shows the approximate subscription price in your local currency.
Your browser sends direct requests to public third-party services (geojs.io, ipwho.is, open.er-api.com) to obtain your country code and current exchange rates.
We do not send your profile data to these services. They only see your IP address, just as they would when you visit any website.
If your browser or ad blocker blocks these requests, the website continues to work in its basic mode: USD prices and the full set of payment methods.
Anonymous analytics (Free and VIP)
When the Helper launches, the following may be sent for public statistics:

items: a unique hardware identifier (HWID), used to count unique users and never displayed publicly;
script version, device type (PC / Mobile), game server number and operating mode (faction).

lines: To disable analytics, open Settings.json in the script folder.

blocks.text: License data (VIP only)
To protect against piracy, the VIP Helper contacts the license server and records:

items: the license key, IP address and User-Agent;

blocks.text: IP addresses and HWIDs are partially masked in your account dashboard.
They are stored in full in the database.
This feature is required for the VIP version to work and cannot be disabled.
Users have the right to request deletion of their personal information.
The procedure depends on the type of data.
Deleting usage statistics (analytics)
To delete your public Helper launch statistics, send a request to bogdan.mtg@gmail.com or message the developer, providing your HWID.
The analytics records will be removed from the database.
Deleting your website profile (account)
You cannot delete your account yourself through the dashboard.
Send a direct message to the developer on Telegram or Discord from the account linked to your profile on mtgmods.com.
Account deletion requests are not accepted by email.
Deleting your account deactivates all active VIP subscriptions.
Data that is not deleted

items: VIP history: records of the devices (HWIDs) used to run the paid VIP version are retained to prevent subscription limit abuse, even after the profile is deleted;
blocklist: when an account is blocked for rule violations such as leaking files or hacking, its Telegram ID, Discord ID and HWIDs remain on a global blocklist to prevent re-registration;
transaction records are retained for financial accounting.

blocks.text: A VIP subscription is a digital product for personal use only.
A key is activated on an account and grants access for a limited duration (7 / 30 / 90 / 365 days), or for a lifetime under certain legacy plans.
VIP is bound to devices (HWIDs) within the plan's device limit.
Devices can be reset through your account within the number of resets available.
The VIP file is personalized. Its download link is single-use.
Each time it launches in the game, the VIP Helper contacts license/check. The script will not load without a successful response.
Prohibited actions

items: sharing your license key, paid Helper file or account access (Telegram / Discord) with third parties;
decompiling, modifying or hacking the paid file;

blocks.text: Consequences of violations

items: leaking a file or key, or sharing an account, results in cancellation of the subscription without a refund;
a deliberate hacking attempt results in permanent blocklisting of the account, social IDs and HWIDs.

blocks.text: A refund is only possible before the key is activated on an account.
The payment is refunded and the key is permanently deleted.
No refunds are available after key activation.
Activating the key counts as delivery of the service, whether or not you have downloaded the VIP file.
Your internet provider blocking the website (mtgmods.com) or API (api.mtgmods.com) is not grounds for a refund.

For users affected by regional blocks: a browser VPN may let you pay for a subscription and download the VIP file, but the script runs inside the game and contacts api.mtgmods.com directly from your PC. If your provider blocks the API, use a system-wide VPN such as WARP or TunnelBear; otherwise, the purchased script will not load.
The software is provided ‘as is’.
The developer does not guarantee full compatibility with every server.
The developer is not responsible for game account bans, loss of in-game assets, game crashes, software damage or any other loss.
Data is not sold to third parties. Browser requests to public country and exchange rate services are described under ‘Localized prices and payment methods’.
